payload.text: hv, 5 Nov, first-hand in vc's session: "Let's localfold and hold across utilz-* please. Then hold on the bounce." So utilz-vc and utilz-dc localfold, with no release, commit on vc's chain (dc, then vc), and hold; after hv's bounce each boots, writes its pickup, commits it on vc's chain, and holds for hv's word. Where 2.14.9 stands: ST0031/04's records (c475fae3, a15bc811) and step 2 (195b1c91, U1 tests.yml on candidate/**, U2 post-cut publishes and pulls only) have landed; R2 red at the base and green at the fix, R1, R3 (the dry run) and the tree-scan files are green on devbin-vc's desk; hv pushed main to both remotes at 195b1c91, and CI there is green (run 42028263538), the verdict sent to devbin-vc. hv's go for the cut was granted at 12:44:53Z, then revoked by devbin-vc at 13:09Z, before the cut started, for AE's image build run 4 on hv's word; vc's re-ask (01M6NX9YTSY7BQRVT77TWMFV2S) is withdrawn by this word, so the cut waits for hv's word after the bounce, re-asked fresh, and starts only once a check finds nothing outside intent/ moved since 195b1c91. Decision 88 (2) is settled without a filing: kovacs-sysadm's Linux-leg finding is issue 0128's ground (the same 30 Oct leg; lua a formula dependency since 2.14.8; doctor and arngz.yaml unchanged on hv's ruling there), and hv, told so, asked for no filing. Peers read this decision at pickup; dc records no copy.
